newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to warn Portugal over Losec-like drugs.
newsitem.headline: EU to warn Portugal over Losec-like drugs.

text.p: The European Commission is to ask the Portuguese government in the coming days to reply to accusations by Swedish company Astra that it allowed copies of Astra's anti-ulcer drug Losec.
"The letter is expected to be sent in the coming days," a Commission spokesman told Reuters.
The move follows a complaint by Astra almost a year ago that Portugal wrongfully authorised the marketing of what the company called pirate copies of its best-selling drug.
Three Portuguese firms counter-attacked at the time saying they would sue the local subsidiary of Astra over the accusations.

The Commission's letter is the first step of a lengthy procedure which could end up in the European Court of Justice if Portugal fails to convince the EU that it was right to approve the Losec-like drugs.
Lisbon will have two months from the moment it receives the letter to submit its views.
